 VisionQuest Post-Credits Scene Is A Major Game-Changer For Avengers: Doomsday With Appearances From Elizabeth Olsen’s Scarlet Witch and Robert Downey Jr.’s Doctor Doom
 Marvel Television's VisionQuest included a massive tease for the next Avengers movie in its post-credits scene.
 By Richard Nebens 
 Posted: November 11, 2026 
 Less than six weeks before Avengers: Doomsday hits theaters, a post-credits scene from VisionQuest set up a major development for the new sequel. Set to be released on December 18, Doomsday will be the first part of a culmination for the entire Marvel universe, including the MCU's 18-year run and legacy Marvel movies produced before the MCU's inception in 2008 . Now, the end of the most recent Disney+ show has officially tied part of its story to a film that looks to be the biggest comic-book movie event in history.
 Warning — the rest of this article contains full spoilers for the post-credits scene from VisionQuest .
 Marvel Studios unveiled a new post-credits scene in the eighth and final episode of VisionQuest , which was not included in press screeners distributed before and during the season's release. 
 Marvel Studios This scene revisits the end of 2022's Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness , when Elizabeth Olsen's Wanda Maximoff destroys the shrine built to honor her on Mount Wundagore and brings the mountain down on top of herself.
 Marvel Studios After dreamwalking into the Earth-838 version of herself and being assured that there are other versions of her twins (Billy and Tommy Maximoff), Wanda tells Doctor Strange (who is dreamwalking into his corpse from Earth-838), "No one will ever be tempted by the Darkhold again." 
 Marvel Studios After that line, she uses her ultra-powerful abilities to pull down the top of the mountain that sits over the shrine to destroy every version of the Darkhold across the multiverse. As the camera cuts to a wide shot of Wundagore collapsing, a red flash bursts from the middle of the structure,  leading many to believe that Wanda perished  under the mountain's weight.
 Marvel Studios After the footage from the Doctor Strange sequel ended, Marvel added about 10 seconds of new material, showing a massive rock being lifted up. Robert Downey Jr.'s Victor Von Doom is revealed lifting rubble as he makes his first appearance in a Disney+ exclusive project.
 Marvel Studios The camera then pans to Elizabeth Olsen's Wanda lying dead, as Doom says,  "Scarlet Witch, awaken...your power will be mine." Doom's green magic then floats towards Wanda, bringing two of Marvel's most notable magic-wielders together in the same scene.
 Marvel Studios Wanda then opens her eyes and gasps in a state of shock as she sees Doom using his powers to take her abilities, before the camera suddenly cuts to black.
 Marvel Studios Notably, this scene parallels another recent moment in the MCU, specifically one of the four post-credits scenes in the re-release of Avengers: Endgame (officially titled Avengers: Endgame Encore ). The scene brings back Mark Ruffalo's Bruce Banner after his appearance in Spider-Man: Brand New Day , revealing that he has barricaded himself in a military complex two miles underground following his first Hulk-out in over a decade.
 Sony Pictures As he records himself on video and discusses a new "gamma suppression serum," the space goes dark as Doctor Doom teleports into the room with Banner. The enormous green rage monster comes out of Banner again, as Doom says, "Mr. Banner, I'm here to collect you." 
 Sony Pictures This news comes on the same day that Anthony Mackie seemed to accidentally indicate that Paul Bettany may have a role as Vision in Avengers: Doomsday following his leading appearance in VisionQuest . Listing off colleagues he got to work with, Mackie recalled getting "to hang out with, you know, Paul Bettany, who I love."  
 This could have been a slip-up on Mackie's part, as he may have meant to say Paul Rudd (Ant-Man), whom he has worked with on multiple occasions and was confirmed for Doomsday 's cast in Marvel Studios' official announcement from March 2025 . However, given how massive the movie's cast is, Bettany having a role in the sequel would not be outside the realm of possibility.
 Scarlet Witch's Expected Role in Avengers: Doomsday
 Considering Wanda is regarded as arguably the strongest character in the MCU , bringing her into play alongside a villain as powerful and iconic as Doctor Doom is sure to have an impact on the story. Her role could also be linked to characters who have been teased for parts alongside Doom — the Latverian Witches.
 Marvel Studios These witches were first shown in a display for Doomsday at San Diego Comic-Con . A costume was shown depicting a woman in long green robes (complete with a hood) similar to Doctor Doom's green cloak. Other figurines were dressed in similar orange and purple cloaks and were officially labeled the "Latverian Witches."
 There is a good chance this post-credits scene means that the Scarlet Witch will be one of the witches assisting Doom in his quest for multiversal domination and/or destruction. 
 While Doom seems to want to take her power for himself in the VisionQuest post-credits scene, he could also place her under a spell that forces her to do his bidding, as he is well-known for his impressive magical abilities. Charlize Theron's Clea and Hayley Atwell's Peggy Carter have been brought up as potential options for the other witches, although Wanda would certainly be the most natural choice when looking at past MCU characters.
 Marvel Studios From here, Doom's collection of Wanda and Hulk should be a key part of Doomsday 's plot as he looks to potentially destroy all life in every universe. Whether he steals their powers for himself or bends them to his will for extra support in his quest, this development only continues to set him up as potentially the most powerful and terrifying villain the MCU has ever delivered .
 The Hulk and Scarlet Witch are sure to be far from the only characters Doom "collects" from the multiverse , as he seems to be looking for the most powerful heroes the MCU has to offer. This could bring other characters like Doctor Strange and Captain Marvel into play, and it could also hint at him going after somebody like Loki, who is confirmed for the cast and now holds a new position as the God of Stories after Loki Season 2.
 From here, with less than six weeks until Doomsday 's debut, the stakes continue to be raised for a film that was already teased to be the biggest event in the history of the MCU.
